in_band_test_facilities.name: PRBS generators/checkers (PMA)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-lane PRBS13/PRBS31-class pattern for SerDes/optical bring-up.

in_band_test_facilities.name: RS-FEC error-injection + counters (PCS MMD)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Inject correctable/uncorrectable symbol errors; read corrected/uncorrected + per-lane symbol-error counters.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Link-training force/disable (PMA/PMD MMD)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Fix equaliser coefficients to characterise the channel.

internal_diagnostics_observability: PCS block-lock, alignment-marker lock, hi-SER flags.
out_of_band_test_facilities: BERT (bit error rate tester) for per-lane PAM4 margin.
Optical reference receiver for DR8/SR8/VR8/2xFR4 PMD compliance.
800G protocol analyzer for frame + PCS capture.
fields.notes: IEEE 802.3df mandates the PCS/FEC observability (lock + counters) and PMA PRBS facilities; JTAG/scan/BIST are vendor-added. The RS-FEC counters are the primary in-system DFT instrument because the 1e-13 target rides on a much worse raw PAM4 lane error ratio.
